title.ja: 角特異性・曲線座標・Neumann／Robin境界
title.en: Corner singularities, curved coordinates and Neumann/Robin boundaries

note.ja: この章に登録された手法・問題・実行例の関連資料です。 L字特異解のP1 FEM、環状領域の可変粘性ベクトルQ1 PDE、純Neumannの互換条件・平均ゲージ、混合Robinの製造解を実際に解きます。
note.en: Resources explicitly registered to the methods, problems and executions of this chapter. Actually solve singular L-corner P1 FEM, annular variable-viscosity vector Q1 PDE, pure-Neumann compatibility/mean-gauge and mixed-Robin manufactured problems.

name.ja: Q1有限要素法（曲線座標ベクトルBVP）
name.en: Q1 FEM for mapped-coordinate vector BVP

name.ja: 連続P1 Galerkin有限要素法
name.en: Continuous P1 Galerkin FEM

note.ja: 面積と物理勾配からP1剛性を組み、境界を消去して疎直接法で解きます。隅要素は原点をDuffy写像の頂点に移し、Gauss48/96を比較。
note.en: Assemble physical P1 gradients/areas, eliminate boundary data and solve sparse systems. Corner triangles use origin-based Duffy quadrature48/96.

name.ja: Q1有限要素法（曲線座標ベクトルBVP）
name.en: Q1 FEM for mapped-coordinate vector BVP

note.ja: polarのmapped Q1にCartesian速度2成分を置き、r dr dthetaで2mu epsilonの弱形式を4×4 Gauss積分してblock疎解法。円周faceにはr dthetaと外向き法線を使う。
note.en: Mapped polar Q1 with two Cartesian velocity components;4×4 Gauss integration of2mu epsilon uses exact r dr dtheta metric, followed by a block sparse solve. Circular traction uses r dtheta and outward normals.

name.ja: 空間中心差分

note.en: Shared-face differences, weighted-mean augmented solve and compatible CG comparison; no physical RHS mean projection.

note.ja: 楕円型境界値問題。符号規約を確認し、反復解法・疎行列・境界条件をたどる。 第4象限を除いた[-1,1]²、theta∈[0,3pi/2]、u=r^(2/3)sin(2theta/3)、解析Dirichlet。N8/16/32、graded map x→x max(|x|,|y|)。正方形sin(pi x)sin(pi y)を同Nのregular/warpedで別検査。

name.ja: 可変粘性のベクトル応力境界値問題
name.en: Variable-viscosity vector stress boundary-value problem

note.ja: Cartesianの2成分を結合した線形応力発散BVPです。極座標内のQ1基底と正確な曲線Jacobianを使い、可変μの勾配と剪断応力を含みます。圧力・非圧縮拘束・対流項はありません。 1≤r≤2、theta周期、mu=1+.2r²、lambda=0、両円でu=0。A(s)=(s−1)(4−s)、u=(A(1+xy),A(x²−y²)/2)。Nr8/16/32、Ntheta=2Nr。
note.en: Linear stress-divergence BVP coupling two Cartesian components. Q1 basis functions in polar coordinates use the exact curved Jacobian and include variable-mu gradients and shear. There is no pressure,incompressibility constraint or advective term. 1≤r≤2, periodic angle, mu=1+.2r², lambda0 and zero velocity on both circles. A(s)=(s−1)(4−s), u=(A(1+xy),A(x²−y²)/2). Nr8/16/32,Ntheta2Nr.

name.ja: L字領域P1特異解：graded格子と歪みの分離：参照・比較条件
name.en: L-corner P1 FEM: grading and separate mesh distortion — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: L2/H1積分誤差・求積差、一様/gradedの同DOF改善、別のsquare/warped系列、最小角・aspect・1ノルム条件数推定・真の線形残差を保存。
note.en: Retain integrated L2/H1 errors, quadrature gaps, matched-DOF grading improvement, separate square/warp errors, minimum angle/aspect, estimated1-norm conditioning and true residuals.

name.ja: L字角の特異解：調和場と別の滑らかな製造解
name.en: L-corner singularity: harmonic field and separate smooth MMS

note.ja: 解析解 第4象限を除いた[-1,1]²、theta∈[0,3pi/2]、u=r^(2/3)sin(2theta/3)、解析Dirichlet。N8/16/32、graded map x→x max(|x|,|y|)。正方形sin(pi x)sin(pi y)を同Nのregular/warpedで別検査。角の解析解と勾配を要素求積し、一様格子と事前graded格子を同じ自由度で比べます。別の単位正方形でsin(πx)sin(πy)をregular/warped格子へ置き、特異性と歪みを分けます。 特異解に正方形のL2二次を要求しません。固定の事前graded写像でありAMRソフトではありません。条件数は推定で、任意歪みへの保証はしません。
note.en: Analytic reference L-shaped[-1,1]² minus quadrantIV, theta0..3pi/2, analytic Dirichlet harmonic corner field. N8/16/32, fixed map x→x max(|x|,|y|). Separate unit-square sine MMS uses regular/warped grids. Integrate the analytic corner field and gradient over elements, comparing uniform and a-priori graded meshes at matched DOFs. A separate unit-square sine MMS on regular/warped meshes separates singularity from distortion. No smooth-square L2 order is imposed on the singular field. Fixed a-priori grading is not an AMR engine. Conditioning is estimated; arbitrary distortion is not certified.

name.ja: 環状領域の可変粘性・真2DベクトルMMS：参照・比較条件
name.en: Annular variable-viscosity vector PDE MMS — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 独自解析外力を別のCartesian応力差分で資格確認。L2速度/歪み/traction細分化、反力/体積外力と物理tractionの収支、粘性散逸と外力仕事を別々に測定。 体積外力の解析積分(756pi/5,0)も別に照合。
note.en: Qualify the derived force by separate Cartesian stress differentiation. Measure velocity/strain/traction refinement, reactions versus volume-force/physical traction budgets, and viscous dissipation versus force work. Also check the independently integrated body force (756pi/5,0).

name.ja: 環状粘性ベクトルMMS：独立応力微分で外力を確認
name.en: Annular vector-viscous MMS: force qualified by independent stress differentiation

note.ja: 製造解 1≤r≤2、theta周期、mu=1+.2r²、lambda=0、両円でu=0。A(s)=(s−1)(4−s)、u=(A(1+xy),A(x²−y²)/2)。Nr8/16/32、Ntheta=2Nr。s=x²+y²、A=(s−1)(4−s)のCartesianベクトル場から応力と外力を解析的に導き、別のCartesian差分応力微分で確認します。体積外力の独立積分(756π/5,0)も照合します。 線形vector粘性BVPです。divfree拘束・圧力・非線形Navier–Stokesは含めません。原点なしのr>0であり、軸stencil検証ではありません。
note.en: Manufactured solution 1≤r≤2, periodic angle, mu=1+.2r², lambda0 and zero velocity on both circles. A(s)=(s−1)(4−s), u=(A(1+xy),A(x²−y²)/2). Nr8/16/32,Ntheta2Nr. Derive stress/force from the Cartesian vector field with s=x²+y²,A=(s-1)(4-s), then qualify force by separate Cartesian stress finite differentiation. Also check independent integrated body force(756pi/5,0). A linear vector viscous BVP, without divergence-free constraint, pressure or nonlinear Navier–Stokes. r>0 only; no axis stencil certification.

name.ja: 純Neumannの互換条件と平均値ゲージ：参照・比較条件
name.en: Pure Neumann compatibility and mean gauge — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: L2細分化、零空間、平均、CG差、source+1拒否、境界流束/体積源の収支を保存。
note.en: Retain L2 refinement, nullspace/gauge/CG gap, source+1 rejection and boundary/source budget.

name.ja: 純Neumann：解析場・互換条件・平均値ゲージ
name.en: Pure Neumann: analytic field, compatibility and mean gauge

note.ja: 製造解 単位正方形N16/32/64、セル中心の点DOF。cos(2pi x)cos(2pi y)、全壁Neumann0、平均0とN32の平均.25診断。u=cos(2πx)cos(2πy)、f=8π²u、外向き法線流束0を点DOFで比較します。平均0と平均.25を分け、source+1の物理的不適合を投影で隠さず拒否します。 同じ半離散系の別線形解法は独立PDE参照ではありません。既存Dirichlet MGの成功や2D任意境界へ一般化しません。
note.en: Manufactured solution Unit square N16/32/64, cell-centred point DOFs, cosine exact field, homogeneous Neumann; mean0 andN32 mean.25 probe. Use point DOFs for u=cos(2pi*x)cos(2pi*y),f=8pi²u and zero outward normal flux. Distinguish means0/.25 and explicitly reject incompatible source+1 rather than projecting it away. A different linear solver of the same matrix is not an independent PDE discretization; no general boundary/MG claim.

name.en: 2D mixed Robin MMS and boundary flux — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 2D解/誤差、真の残差、Robin関係残差と解析法線flux誤差、3格子細分化と積分収支を保存。
note.en: Save2D solution/errors, true residuals, Robin relation and analytic normal-flux errors, three-grid refinement and integral budget.

name.ja: 混合Robin：2次元解析場と独立な法線流束
name.en: Mixed Robin: 2D analytic field and independent normal flux

note.ja: 製造解 単位正方形N16/32/64、u=cos(pi x)cos(2pi y)+x+y。x壁Neumann±1、y壁alpha1,beta.5の解析Robin。f=5π²cos(πx)cos(2πy)を使い、x壁は外向きNeumann±1、y壁はαu+β∂nu=gの解析値です。境界条件の代数残差と、解析的な物理法線流束の誤差を別々に測ります。 Robin問題は一意なので平均ゲージを重ねません。境界条件の代数残差と物理flux精度を区別します。
note.en: Manufactured solution Unit square N16/32/64; cosine-plus-linear exact field. x walls Neumann±1; y walls analytic Robin alpha1,beta.5. Use f=5pi²cos(pi*x)cos(2pi*y),outward Neumann±1 on x walls and analytic alpha*u+beta*dn(u)=g on y walls. Distinguish algebraic boundary-relation residual from analytic physical-normal-flux error. The unique Robin problem has no additional mean gauge. Algebraic boundary satisfaction differs from physical flux accuracy.

name.ja: L字領域P1特異解：graded格子と歪みの分離：参照・検証
name.en: L-corner P1 FEM: grading and separate mesh distortion — references and checks

note.ja: L2/H1積分誤差・求積差、一様/gradedの同DOF改善、別のsquare/warped系列、最小角・aspect・1ノルム条件数推定・真の線形残差を保存。
note.en: Retain integrated L2/H1 errors, quadrature gaps, matched-DOF grading improvement, separate square/warp errors, minimum angle/aspect, estimated1-norm conditioning and true residuals.

name.ja: L字角の特異解：調和場と別の滑らかな製造解
name.en: L-corner singularity: harmonic field and separate smooth MMS

note.ja: 解析解 第4象限を除いた[-1,1]²、theta∈[0,3pi/2]、u=r^(2/3)sin(2theta/3)、解析Dirichlet。N8/16/32、graded map x→x max(|x|,|y|)。正方形sin(pi x)sin(pi y)を同Nのregular/warpedで別検査。角の解析解と勾配を要素求積し、一様格子と事前graded格子を同じ自由度で比べます。別の単位正方形でsin(πx)sin(πy)をregular/warped格子へ置き、特異性と歪みを分けます。 特異解に正方形のL2二次を要求しません。固定の事前graded写像でありAMRソフトではありません。条件数は推定で、任意歪みへの保証はしません。
note.en: Analytic reference L-shaped[-1,1]² minus quadrantIV, theta0..3pi/2, analytic Dirichlet harmonic corner field. N8/16/32, fixed map x→x max(|x|,|y|). Separate unit-square sine MMS uses regular/warped grids. Integrate the analytic corner field and gradient over elements, comparing uniform and a-priori graded meshes at matched DOFs. A separate unit-square sine MMS on regular/warped meshes separates singularity from distortion. No smooth-square L2 order is imposed on the singular field. Fixed a-priori grading is not an AMR engine. Conditioning is estimated; arbitrary distortion is not certified.

name.ja: 環状領域の可変粘性・真2DベクトルMMS：参照・検証
name.en: Annular variable-viscosity vector PDE MMS — references and checks

note.ja: 独自解析外力を別のCartesian応力差分で資格確認。L2速度/歪み/traction細分化、反力/体積外力と物理tractionの収支、粘性散逸と外力仕事を別々に測定。 体積外力の解析積分(756pi/5,0)も別に照合。
note.en: Qualify the derived force by separate Cartesian stress differentiation. Measure velocity/strain/traction refinement, reactions versus volume-force/physical traction budgets, and viscous dissipation versus force work. Also check the independently integrated body force (756pi/5,0).

name.ja: 環状粘性ベクトルMMS：独立応力微分で外力を確認
name.en: Annular vector-viscous MMS: force qualified by independent stress differentiation

note.ja: 製造解 1≤r≤2、theta周期、mu=1+.2r²、lambda=0、両円でu=0。A(s)=(s−1)(4−s)、u=(A(1+xy),A(x²−y²)/2)。Nr8/16/32、Ntheta=2Nr。s=x²+y²、A=(s−1)(4−s)のCartesianベクトル場から応力と外力を解析的に導き、別のCartesian差分応力微分で確認します。体積外力の独立積分(756π/5,0)も照合します。 線形vector粘性BVPです。divfree拘束・圧力・非線形Navier–Stokesは含めません。原点なしのr>0であり、軸stencil検証ではありません。
note.en: Manufactured solution 1≤r≤2, periodic angle, mu=1+.2r², lambda0 and zero velocity on both circles. A(s)=(s−1)(4−s), u=(A(1+xy),A(x²−y²)/2). Nr8/16/32,Ntheta2Nr. Derive stress/force from the Cartesian vector field with s=x²+y²,A=(s-1)(4-s), then qualify force by separate Cartesian stress finite differentiation. Also check independent integrated body force(756pi/5,0). A linear vector viscous BVP, without divergence-free constraint, pressure or nonlinear Navier–Stokes. r>0 only; no axis stencil certification.

name.ja: 純Neumannの互換条件と平均値ゲージ：参照・検証
name.en: Pure Neumann compatibility and mean gauge — references and checks

note.ja: L2細分化、零空間、平均、CG差、source+1拒否、境界流束/体積源の収支を保存。
note.en: Retain L2 refinement, nullspace/gauge/CG gap, source+1 rejection and boundary/source budget.

name.ja: 純Neumann：解析場・互換条件・平均値ゲージ
name.en: Pure Neumann: analytic field, compatibility and mean gauge

note.ja: 製造解 単位正方形N16/32/64、セル中心の点DOF。cos(2pi x)cos(2pi y)、全壁Neumann0、平均0とN32の平均.25診断。u=cos(2πx)cos(2πy)、f=8π²u、外向き法線流束0を点DOFで比較します。平均0と平均.25を分け、source+1の物理的不適合を投影で隠さず拒否します。 同じ半離散系の別線形解法は独立PDE参照ではありません。既存Dirichlet MGの成功や2D任意境界へ一般化しません。
note.en: Manufactured solution Unit square N16/32/64, cell-centred point DOFs, cosine exact field, homogeneous Neumann; mean0 andN32 mean.25 probe. Use point DOFs for u=cos(2pi*x)cos(2pi*y),f=8pi²u and zero outward normal flux. Distinguish means0/.25 and explicitly reject incompatible source+1 rather than projecting it away. A different linear solver of the same matrix is not an independent PDE discretization; no general boundary/MG claim.

name.ja: 2D混合Robinの製造解と境界流束：参照・検証
name.en: 2D mixed Robin MMS and boundary flux — references and checks

note.ja: 2D解/誤差、真の残差、Robin関係残差と解析法線flux誤差、3格子細分化と積分収支を保存。
note.en: Save2D solution/errors, true residuals, Robin relation and analytic normal-flux errors, three-grid refinement and integral budget.

name.ja: 混合Robin：2次元解析場と独立な法線流束
name.en: Mixed Robin: 2D analytic field and independent normal flux

note.ja: 製造解 単位正方形N16/32/64、u=cos(pi x)cos(2pi y)+x+y。x壁Neumann±1、y壁alpha1,beta.5の解析Robin。f=5π²cos(πx)cos(2πy)を使い、x壁は外向きNeumann±1、y壁はαu+β∂nu=gの解析値です。境界条件の代数残差と、解析的な物理法線流束の誤差を別々に測ります。 Robin問題は一意なので平均ゲージを重ねません。境界条件の代数残差と物理flux精度を区別します。
note.en: Manufactured solution Unit square N16/32/64; cosine-plus-linear exact field. x walls Neumann±1; y walls analytic Robin alpha1,beta.5. Use f=5pi²cos(pi*x)cos(2pi*y),outward Neumann±1 on x walls and analytic alpha*u+beta*dn(u)=g on y walls. Distinguish algebraic boundary-relation residual from analytic physical-normal-flux error. The unique Robin problem has no additional mean gauge. Algebraic boundary satisfaction differs from physical flux accuracy.
